category: TOEIC Part 5 / 詞性與文法
question: The newly appointed CEO stressed that every department must submit its quarterly budget proposal ______ by Friday afternoon.
explanation:
【考點分析：副詞修飾動詞】
句中動詞為 submit（提交），此處需要副詞 promptly（迅速地、準時地）來修飾動詞片語 submit ... by Friday afternoon。
(A) prompt (adj. 迅速的 / v. 促使)
(B) promptly (adv. 準時地、即刻地) 👉 正確答案
(C) promptness (n. 敏捷、及時)
(D) prompting (n. 激勵、提示)

category: 学测文法 / 關係代名詞與介系詞
question: The renewable energy project, ______ the municipal government invested millions of dollars, has finally reached full operational capacity.
explanation:
【考點分析：介系詞 + 關係代名詞】
還原後方子句為：'The municipal government invested millions of dollars IN the renewable energy project.'
由於先行詞是 the renewable energy project，且動詞 invest 的固定搭配為 invest in sth，移到關係代名詞前面時形成 'in which'。
注意：逗號後的非限定子句不可使用 that。

category: TOEIC Part 5 / 假設語氣與動詞時態
question: Had the shipment ______ inspected before leaving the warehouse, the defective components would not have reached the overseas retailers.
explanation:
【考點分析：與過去事實相反的假設語氣倒裝】
原句為：'If the shipment had been inspected..., the defective components would not have reached...'
省略連接詞 If 時，助動詞 Had 需移至主詞 the shipment 前形成倒裝：'Had the shipment been inspected'。
因此空格應填入過去分詞 been。

category: 学测克漏字題組 / 科技與環境
passage: Urban greening initiatives have gained momentum worldwide as cities grapple with the 'urban heat island' effect. By planting rooftop gardens and preserving native flora, municipalities can significantly mitigate ambient temperatures. (1)______, these vegetative barriers act as natural sponges during torrential downpours, reducing the risk of catastrophic flash floods. Environmental planners emphasize that urban ecosystems (2)______ foster biodiversity, but also tangibly enhance residents' psychological well-being.

questions.label: 空格 (1)
questions.question: Choose the most appropriate transition word for blank (1):
questions.explanation: 前句說明植被能降低溫度，後句補充說明植被還能在暴雨時吸收水分防洪，語意為「遞進補充關係」，因此應選 Furthermore（此外；而且）。

questions.label: 空格 (2)
questions.question: Choose the correct correlative conjunction for blank (2):
questions.explanation: 後方出現 'but also tangibly enhance...'，對應英語常見關聯對等連接詞片語 'not only A but also B'（不僅…而且…），故選 not only。

category: TOEIC Part 5 / 主謂一致與不定代名詞
question: Neither the head of the marketing team nor any of the junior analysts ______ willing to take full responsibility for the delayed campaign.
explanation:
【考點分析：Neither A nor B 主謂就近一致原則】
使用 'Neither A nor B' 連接兩個主詞時，動詞的單複數形態應與靠近動詞的後方主詞 (B) 一致。
此處靠近動詞的主詞為 'any of the junior analysts'（複數），因此動詞需用複數形式 were (be willing to 樂意做某事)。

category: TOEIC Part 5 / 關係代名詞與結構
question: Candidates ______ applications meet all statutory requirements will be summoned for an in-person panel interview next week.
explanation:
【考點分析：所有格關係代名詞 whose】
句中先行詞為 Candidates（求職者，人），後方接著名詞 applications（申請表），兩者具所有格關係（求職者『的』申請表符合所有法定要求），故應選關係代名詞所有格 whose。
(A) who (主格關係代名詞，後接動詞)
(B) whom (受格關係代名詞)
(C) whose (所有格關係代名詞，後接名詞) 👉 正確答案
(D) which (用於指代事物先行詞)

category: 學測克漏字 / 轉折連接詞
question: Renewable energy costs have declined significantly in recent years; ______, utility companies must still address the storage challenges posed by intermittent generation.
explanation:
【考點分析：轉折副詞 nevertheless】
前半句指出「再生能源成本顯著下降」，後半句轉折指出「電力公司仍須解決間歇發電的儲能挑戰」，兩者呈現對比與轉折關係，因此選 nevertheless（然而、儘管如此）。
(A) nevertheless (adv. 儘管如此、然而) 👉 正確答案
(B) furthermore (adv. 此外、而且)
(C) consequently (adv. 因此、結果)
(D) similarly (adv. 同樣地)

category: TOEIC Part 5 / 假設語氣與倒裝
question: ______ you require additional legal documentation regarding the licensing contract, please notify the compliance officer immediately.
explanation:
【考點分析：未來條件句 if 倒裝省略】
原句為 'If you should require additional legal documentation...'，在正式商業書信中，省略 if 時應將助動詞 Should 倒裝置於句首（Should you require...），表「萬一 / 若您需要…」。
(A) Were (用於與現在事實相反之倒裝，如 Were you a lawyer...)
(B) Had (用於與過去事實相反之倒裝，如 Had you told me...)
(C) Should (用於未來可能情況之倒裝，相當於 If you should...) 👉 正確答案
(D) Would (不能直接用於倒裝條件句首)

category: TOEIC Part 5 / 動詞受詞補語與使役
question: The newly installed security protocols will enable enterprise employees ______ confidential cloud drives securely from home.
explanation:
【考點分析：enable + O + to V】
動詞 enable（使能夠）的慣用搭配為 enable someone to do something（使某人能夠做某事），受詞補語必須使用不定詞 to V。
(A) access (原形動詞)
(B) to access (不定詞) 👉 正確答案
(C) accessing (現在分詞/動名詞)
(D) accessed (過去分詞)

category: 學測克漏字 / 慣用介系詞搭配
question: The ongoing urban reforestation project is in accordance ______ the municipal government's zero-carbon pledge for 2030.
explanation:
【考點分析：片語 in accordance with】
in accordance with 為高頻正式片語，意為「符合；與…一致；依據…」。
(A) with 👉 正確答案（in accordance with）
(B) for
(C) to (注：according to 或 in accordance with)
(D) by

category: TOEIC Part 5 / 分詞構句與主被動
question: ______ by the regional sales figures of the previous quarter, the steering board decided to expand operations into Southeast Asia.
explanation:
【考點分析：過去分詞構句表示被動】
主詞 the steering board（指導委員會）與動詞 encourage（激勵、鼓舞）之間為「被動關係」（受到前一季亮眼銷售數據的鼓舞），原句為 'Because the steering board was encouraged by...'，省略連接詞與 be 動詞後保留過去分詞 Encouraged 開頭。
(A) Encourage (原形動詞)
(B) Encouraging (現在分詞，表主動或令人鼓舞的)
(C) Encouraged (過去分詞，表感到鼓舞的) 👉 正確答案
(D) Having encourage (文法錯誤，完成式應為 Having encouraged)

category: 學測克漏字 / 邏輯因果關係
question: The international symposium had to be postponed ______ unexpected travel restrictions imposed across European transport hubs.
explanation:
【考點分析：介系詞片語 due to + 名詞】
空格後方為名詞片語 unexpected travel restrictions...，表示「因為突發的旅行限制」，因此應選介系詞片語 due to（因為、由於）。because 是連接詞需後接完整子句。
(A) because (連接詞，後需接 S + V)
(B) due to (介系詞片語，後接名詞/名詞片語) 👉 正確答案
(C) in spite of (介系詞片語，表「儘管」，語意相反)
(D) as though (連接詞，表「彷彿、好像」)

category: TOEIC Part 5 / 詞性辨析（形容詞與副詞）
question: To uphold data integrity, all automated backup logs must be reviewed ______ by certified security specialists.
explanation:
【考點分析：副詞修飾被動態動詞片語】
句中動詞為 must be reviewed（必須被審核），此處需要副詞 rigorously（嚴格地、周密地）來修飾動作 reviewed。
(A) rigor (n. 嚴謹、嚴酷)
(B) rigorous (adj. 嚴格的、縝密的)
(C) rigorously (adv. 嚴格地、嚴密地) 👉 正確答案
(D) rigorousness (n. 嚴謹性)

category: 學測克漏字 / 比較級與慣用句型
question: The more conscientiously students review their spaced-repetition flashcards, the ______ they can retain newly acquired academic vocabulary.
explanation:
【考點分析：The + 比較級 ..., the + 比較級 ...】
本題考「越…就越…」句型：The more conscientiously ..., the more effectively ...。後半句修飾動詞 retain（記住），故需使用副詞 effectively 的比較級 more effectively。
(A) effectively (原級副詞)
(B) more effectively (比較級副詞) 👉 正確答案
(C) most effectively (最高級副詞)
(D) effect (名詞)

category: TOEIC Part 5 / 堅決建議動詞與 That 子句原形動詞
question: The senior safety inspector insisted that the chemical laboratory ______ all hazardous materials before the scheduled audit.
explanation:
【考點分析：堅持/建議/要求動詞後的 that 子句使用原形動詞】
動詞 insisted（堅持要求）表示強烈要求或命令，其後接 that 子句時，子句動詞慣用「(should) + 原形動詞」，should 通常省略，故即使主詞 the chemical laboratory 為單數，動詞仍用原形 relocate！
(A) relocate (原形動詞，省略 should) 👉 正確答案
(B) relocates (第三人稱單數現在式，不符此文法規則)
(C) relocated (過去式)
(D) will relocate (未來式)

category: TOEIC Part 5 / 不定代名詞主謂一致
question: Each of the regional branch managers ______ required to submit a comprehensive fiscal report before the annual shareholders' assembly.
explanation:
【考點分析：Each of + 複數名詞，主詞為單數 Each】
本題主詞為代名詞 Each（每一個），後方的 of the regional branch managers 為介系詞片語作修飾語。依照主謂一致原則，Each 恆為單數，因此現在式動詞須選單數 is。
(A) is (第三人稱單數現在式 be 動詞) 👉 正確答案
(B) are (複數)
(C) were (複數過去式)
(D) have been (複數完成式)

category: 學測克漏字 / 關係副詞與先行詞
question: The newly inaugurated tech park provides an inspiring collaborative incubator ______ aspiring software entrepreneurs can test algorithmic prototypes.
explanation:
【考點分析：關係副詞 where 引導地方關係子句】
先行詞為 an inspiring collaborative incubator（一個鼓舞人心的協作孵化器，表場所），後方子句 aspiring software entrepreneurs can test algorithmic prototypes 為結構完整之句子（S+V+O完整），在子句中作地方副詞（in which = where），故選關係副詞 where。
(A) where (關係副詞，修飾地點場所) 👉 正確答案
(B) which (關係代名詞，後方須缺少主詞或受詞)
(C) that (關係代名詞)
(D) whose (所有格關係代名詞，後接名詞)

category: TOEIC Part 5 / 複合名詞與動名詞
question: The executive management team expressed deep appreciation for Mr. Davis's ______ contributions to overseas market expansion.
explanation:
【考點分析：形容詞修飾名詞】
空格後為名詞 contributions（貢獻），其前方需要一個形容詞來修飾名詞，故應選 significant（重大的、顯著的）。
(A) signify (動詞，象徵、意味著)
(B) significantly (副詞，顯著地)
(C) significant (形容詞，重大的、顯著的) 👉 正確答案
(D) significance (名詞，重要性)

category: TOEIC Part 5 / 授與動詞與介系詞
question: The senior research grant was awarded ______ Dr. Lin for her groundbreaking discoveries in semiconductor nanotechnology.
explanation:
【考點分析：被動語態 award something to someone】
主動語態為 'award someone something' 或 'award something to someone'。轉為被動語態時，受詞 the senior research grant 作主詞，後接介系詞 to（The grant was awarded to Dr. Lin），表頒發給某人。
(A) for (表原因，此處後方接人)
(B) to (表對象，頒發給…) 👉 正確答案
(C) with
(D) from

category: 學測克漏字 / 轉折副詞與語氣
question: The experimental drug demonstrated moderate efficacy in laboratory mice; ______, human clinical trials failed to reproduce comparable therapeutic results.
explanation:
【考點分析：轉折副詞 however】
前半句「在白鼠實驗中展現適度療效」，分號後後半句「人類臨床試驗未能重現相應療效」，兩句語意形成強烈對比與轉折，故選 however（然而）。
(A) however (adv. 然而、可是) 👉 正確答案
(B) moreover (adv. 此外、而且)
(C) therefore (adv. 因此、所以)
(D) meanwhile (adv. 與此同時)

category: TOEIC Part 5 / 連接詞 as soon as vs once
question: ______ all confidential nondisclosure agreements are fully executed, the proprietary engineering blueprints will be released.
explanation:
【考點分析：從屬連接詞 Once（一旦…就…）】
空格後接完整子句 all ... agreements are fully executed（主詞 + 被動動詞），需要從屬連接詞。During 與 Despite 均為介系詞不能接子句；Unless 表「除非」，語意不通；Once 表「一旦…（就…）」，完美契合句意。
(A) Once (從屬連接詞，一旦…) 👉 正確答案
(B) During (介系詞，在…期間)
(C) Unless (從屬連接詞，除非)
(D) Despite (介系詞，儘管)

category: 學測克漏字 / 複合關係代名詞 what
question: Modern cognitive psychologists emphasize that ______ matters most in deep learning is sustained deliberate practice, not innate talent.
explanation:
【考點分析：複合關係代名詞 what 作主詞】
that 子句內部需要一個兼具先行詞與關係代名詞功能的主詞（the thing which = what），what matters most 構成名詞子句「最重要的事情」，在此名詞子句中擔任動詞 matters 的主詞。
(A) which (須有先行詞)
(B) that (名詞子句連接詞，但在內部子句中不作主詞受詞)
(C) what (= that which，最重要之事) 👉 正確答案
(D) how (副詞，表方式)

category: TOEIC Part 5 / 使役動詞 have/make/let
question: The facilities director had the outdated ventilation ducts ______ and sanitized before the re-opening of the school campus.
explanation:
【考點分析：使役動詞 have + 受詞 + 過去分詞 p.p.（使某物被…）】
have + 物（outdated ventilation ducts）+ p.p. 表示主詞安排讓某物「被檢查與消毒」。ducts（通風管線）與 inspect（檢查）為被動關係，故受詞補語使用過去分詞 inspected。
(A) inspect (主動原形)
(B) inspected (過去分詞，表被動) 👉 正確答案
(C) inspecting (現在分詞)
(D) to inspect (不定詞)

category: TOEIC Part 5 / 介系詞 prior to
question: All international flight attendants must attend a mandatory security briefing prior ______ their designated departure time.
explanation:
【考點分析：慣用介系詞片語 prior to】
prior to 是高頻片語，等同於 before，意為「在…之前」，固定搭配介系詞 to。
(A) at
(B) to 👉 正確答案（prior to）
(C) on
(D) for

category: 學測克漏字 / 假設語氣與省略
question: If the government ______ proactive flood containment infrastructure ten years ago, yesterday's catastrophic damage could have been avoided.
explanation:
【考點分析：與過去事實相反的假設語氣】
主要子句為 'could have been avoided'（過去虛擬式），時間狀語為 ten years ago（十年前），因此條件 if 子句必須使用過去完成式 had + p.p.（had invested）來表達與過去事實相反之假設。
(A) invests (現在式)
(B) had invested (過去完成式) 👉 正確答案
(C) invested (過去簡單式，與現在事實相反)
(D) would invest

category: TOEIC Part 5 / 不定詞作目的狀語
question: ______ employee satisfaction and retention, HR launched a comprehensive flexible working program.
explanation:
【考點分析：不定詞片語 To V 表目的】
句首的不定詞片語 To boost employee satisfaction... 作為全句的目的副詞修飾語，表「為了提升員工滿意度與留任率，HR 推出了…」。
(A) Boost (原形動詞)
(B) To boost (不定詞表目的) 👉 正確答案
(C) Boosted (過去分詞)
(D) Boosting for (文法錯誤)

category: 學測克漏字 / 連接片語 in addition to
question: In addition ______ providing free public transit for senior citizens, the city council subsidizes solar panel installation.
explanation:
【考點分析：片語 In addition to + V-ing/N】
In addition to 為固定搭配介系詞片語，意為「除了…之外（還有…）」，注意其中的 to 為介系詞，後接動名詞 providing。
(A) with
(B) to 👉 正確答案（In addition to）
(C) for
(D) at

category: TOEIC Part 5 / 形容詞子句簡化分詞
question: Passengers ______ on Flight TW-802 to London are requested to report to Boarding Gate 24 immediately.
explanation:
【考點分析：過去分詞片語修飾名詞】
Passengers（乘客）與 book（訂位）為被動關係（乘客是被登記訂位的），原形容詞子句為 'who are booked on Flight TW-802'，簡化後保留過去分詞 booked 作後位修飾。
(A) book (原形動詞)
(B) booking (現在分詞)
(C) booked (過去分詞，表已被訂位的乘客) 👉 正確答案
(D) are booked (此處全句已有主要動詞 are requested，不可再有第二個獨立謂語動詞)

category: TOEIC Part 5 / 副詞修飾形容詞
question: The new battery cells developed by the startup are ______ efficient compared with traditional lithium alternatives.
explanation:
【考點分析：副詞修飾形容詞】
空格後為形容詞 efficient（有效率的），修飾形容詞必須使用副詞 remarkably（顯著地、非常地）。
(A) remark (動詞/名詞)
(B) remarkable (形容詞)
(C) remarkably (副詞) 👉 正確答案
(D) remarkableness (名詞)

category: 學測克漏字 / 假設條件與倒裝
question: ______ it not been for the prompt intervention of emergency responders, the warehouse fire would have caused irreversible devastation.
explanation:
【考點分析：Had it not been for...（若非當時…）】
本題考與過去事實相反的固定句型：'If it had not been for...'，省略 If 時倒裝為 'Had it not been for...'，意為「若非當時有急救人員的迅速介入」。主要子句搭配 would have caused，完全對應過去虛擬語氣。
(A) Had 👉 正確答案（Had it not been for）
(B) Were (用於與現在事實相反：Were it not for...)
(C) Should
(D) Would
